# Quaternius Downtown City MegaKit Standard

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/downtowncitymegakit.html
- Edition: Standard free edition
- Creator: Quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Retrieved: 2026-07-12

## Project Import

This project retains the 153 Unity-oriented FBX files and the standard PNG
texture set. Duplicate Unreal Engine and Godot exports are omitted. The
textures are the original full-resolution files (up to 2048 px); the earlier
1024 px downsize was reverted on 2026-07-12 when the prototype memory budget
was deprioritized. The optional HDR interior cubemaps are omitted because the
free edition does not include the matching Unity shader setup.

Project-owned materials, prefab wrappers, colliders, and integration code live
under `Assets/_Project`; do not edit the imported files in place.
